entities.name: Rath
entities.description: An artificial plane made of flowstone that the Phyrexians used as a staging point to invade Dominaria.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The target plane that Rath expands to merge with.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: The invaders who created and ran Rath.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: The Phyrexian leader said to have created Rath and who ordered its use to store troops and plan the invasion.

entities.name: Evincars
entities.description: Phyrexian agents who ruled Rath as appointed fiefdom lords under Yawgmoth.

entities.name: Eladamri
entities.description: The leader of an uprising against the evincar, raided Chireef and was pronounced Korvecdal.

entities.name: The Hub
entities.description: A machine like a three-mile volcano at Rath's center that spewed flowstone and housed the Stronghold.

entities.name: Flowstone
entities.description: A somewhat intelligent substance from which Rath was mostly made and by which it expanded.

entities.name: Kor, Vec, and Dal
entities.description: The three tribal peoples of Rath who battled for survival.

entities.name: Skyshroud elves
entities.description: Dominarian elves who were transported to Rath and created Skyshroud.

entities.name: Rootwater merfolk
entities.description: Merfolk transported to Rath who descended into savage lives under Skyshroud.

entities.name: Thalakos
entities.description: Dominarians trapped in the Shadows and driven insane.

entities.name: Dauthi
entities.description: Dominarians trapped in the Shadows and driven insane.

entities.name: Soltari
entities.description: Dominarians trapped in the Shadows who remained sane through religion.

entities.name: The Shadows
entities.description: The void between Rath and Dominaria.

entities.name: Parallax
entities.description: A phenomenon of expanding light that dissolved all solid objects it touched.

entities.name: Volrath
entities.description: An evincar of Rath, succeeded by Crovax.

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: A skyship whose crew visited Rath.

events.summary: Yawgmoth is said to have created Rath after the fall of the Shard.
events.quote: It was said to be created by Yawgmoth , sometime after the fall of the Shard .

events.summary: Yawgmoth orders Rath used to store troops and plan the attack on Dominaria, hidden in a pocket plane.
events.quote: Yawgmoth ordered the use of Rath for the storage of Phyrexian troops and the formulation of his plan to attack Dominaria.

events.summary: The evincars put down revolts by the Kor, Vec, Dal and Skyshroud elves.
events.quote: These rulers had to put down the revolts of Rath's inhabitants

events.summary: Barrier disturbances pull Dominarian creatures into Rath, and the Thalakos, Dauthi and Soltari become trapped in the Shadows.
events.quote: They were all trapped within the " Shadows ," the extraplanar space between Rath and Dominaria.

events.summary: The elves' and merfolk's floating home is transported to Rath; they fight, and the elves create Skyshroud while the merfolk are driven into the swamp below.
events.quote: the elves and merfolk began to run out of resources and eventually faced each other in armed conflict

events.summary: Eladamri raids the Stronghold outpost at Chireef and kills all Rathi troops.
events.quote: which was raided by Eladamri and all Rathi troops were killed
